title: Agent Evidence Package (aep/1)
description: Machine-readable counterpart to the format contract published in this repository's README. It describes the SHAPE of an aep/1 document; it cannot describe its INTEGRITY. No JSON Schema can express that link[i] equals sha256(link[i-1] || digest[i]), that digest[i] equals sha256 of the canonical finding, that the genesis hash binds the chain to this package's window and policy, or that the detached signature covers the canonical bytes. A document can satisfy this schema completely and still be forged. Validating against it is a precondition for verification, never a substitute: run the verifier. Members this verifier does not interpret (generatedAt, sessions, conventions, controls, and anything a later producer adds) are carried verbatim and covered by the signature, so the schema leaves them unconstrained rather than pinning a shape it has no authority over.

version.description: The package format. This verifier understands exactly one.

generatedAt.description: When the producer emitted the package. Covered by the signature, not interpreted by the verifier.

window.description: The period the evidence covers. Bound into the chain's genesis hash, so a chain cannot be transplanted onto a different window.

policy.description: The match policy the corroboration join ran under. Bound into the genesis hash alongside the window.

findings.description: The hash-chained findings, in chain order. The chain relationships between these entries are the verifier's business, not the schema's.

chainedFinding.description: One chain link. The finding itself is evidence content the verifier hashes but does not interpret, so its interior is unconstrained here.

index.description: Position in the chain. The verifier requires this to equal the array index.

finding.description: The evidence content. Hashed verbatim; its shape belongs to the producing engine, not to this verifier.

chainHead.description: Summary of the chain. Every field here is a claim the verifier re-derives from the document's own bytes.

algo.description: The only chain algorithm defined for aep/1.

length.description: Declared number of findings. The verifier requires this to match the array.

signatureBundle.description: The detached signature envelope. Optional: a package may be explicitly unsigned, and the verifier reports that as a distinct outcome rather than a failure. The PascalCase member names are the real wire format, produced by the engine marshalling an untagged Go struct; they are not a mistake and must not be normalised.

Signature.description: ASN.1 DER ECDSA signature, base64. Covers the document with the top-level signature member removed and insignificant whitespace stripped.

KeyRef.description: Identifies the signing key to a reader. Carried, not trusted: the verifier checks the signature against the key it was given, not against this string.

Algo.description: The only signing algorithm defined for aep/1.
